concept: How a drive-by-wire pedal actually works
angle: Factual explainer: on a DBW car the pedal is a sensor, the ECU decides the throttle opening, an electric motor moves the throttle plate and reports back; so pedal response is a setting. Q&A separates a pedal module from an ECU tune using FD's own listings and tiers. No gains.
